values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April-October) / off-season (November-March) basic $15 / $14, electric 30A $27 / $23, electric 50A $29 / $25, family electric 30A $48 / $42. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads, two electrical connections) takes one reservation fee.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/thousand-hills-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('ON-SEASON (April through October)', 'OFF-SEASON (November through March)', 'Basic $15 $14', 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23', 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25', 'Family/Electric 30 AMP $48 $42', 'Camping rates include sales tax') + CampingFees_ThousandHills_26_0.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. The 12 basic sites (24-37) are 41-58 ft paved pads on the booking grid, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

discounts.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/thousand-hills-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('A $2 PER NIGHT CAMPING DISCOUNT is available year-round for senior citizens (65 years and older), persons with disabilities, military and veterans'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: 50 campsites on the booking grid: Campground 1 (12 basic, 21 electric 30A, 4 electric 50A, 4 family electric 30A; paved pads) and Campground 2 (9 electric 30A, gravel). Pads 36-82 ft; 9 pull-throughs (15, 20, 25, 27, 29, 36, 37, 47, 55).

values.note: Showers and modern restrooms April-October; in the off-season potable water is at Campground 2.

values.note: Campground 1 takes reservations April 1-October 31; Campground 2 year-round.

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/thousand-hills-state-park/camping ('reserve your Missouri State Parks campsite up to 12 months in advance'; table, Reservations 'Apr 1-Oct 31' Campground 1, 'Year-round' Campground 2; 'Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved'; 'Camping is limited to any 15 days within a 30-consecutive-day period'), read 2026-11-07

note: Two wooded campgrounds above Forest Lake near Kirksville. Campground 1 has the paved electric and family sites plus a basic loop at its east end; Campground 2's nine gravel electric sites stay open through winter. Sites sit 100 m or more back from the water through woods, though the photo of basic site 33 shows the lake through the trees. Boat and ATV trailers may park on the grass. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12 (2027 = 2026), 50A; added military $2, 50 sites to 82 ft with 9 pull-throughs, showers/flush/vault/dump/water/store, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round (CG2). Not a split (~500 m apart). Pin is ~1.6 km off at the dam (flag). Waterfront: filtered lakeview from site 33's official photo (flag, proposed up from not waterfront).
flags: WATERFRONT proposed UP not waterfront -> lakeview: the official UseDirect photo of basic site 033 (msp-content.usedirect.com/images/Missouri/ParkImages/Units/13493.jpg) shows Forest Lake through the trees; per AWH 2026-11-01 a filtered view in official photos from even a few RV sites earns *view. Only that one photo shows water (024-037 and 056-058 photos checked; 034 shows a bright gap that may be water).
